items.quote: And Joseph said unto his brethren, I die
items.claim: Joseph declares to his brethren that he will die

items.quote: and bring you out of this land unto the land which he sware to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob
items.claim: God will bring Joseph's brethren out of this land into the land God swore to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob
items.place: out of this land unto the land which he sware to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob

items.quote: the land which he sware to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob
items.claim: God swore an oath to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob concerning a land
